meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在每次对话前自动回忆之前存储的相关信息，并在每次对话后自动保存新的要点，实现跨会话的持久记忆。
howto.when: 当使用 Claude Code 模式（--target claude-code）且代理提供商为 Claude 时，每次容器启动后自动激活记忆功能。

say.text: 你还记得我们上次讨论的项目计划吗？
say.note: Claude 会从记忆中检索相关上下文。

say.text: 请记住这个重要日期：2025年6月1日。
say.note: Claude 会在本轮对话后存储该信息。

say.text: 基于之前的对话，帮我总结一下进展。
say.note: Claude 会结合记忆生成总结。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically recalls relevant past context before each response and stores new insights after each turn, enabling persistent memory across sessions.
howto.when_en: When using Claude Code mode (--target claude-code) with the Claude provider, the memory hooks activate on every container start.

say_en.text: Do you remember the project plan we discussed last time?
say_en.note: Claude retrieves relevant context from memory.

say_en.text: Please remember this important date: June 1, 2025.
say_en.note: Claude stores the information after this turn.

say_en.text: Based on previous conversations, summarize the progress.
say_en.note: Claude uses memory to generate the summary.
